critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettingsTab.js fetchSettings retry/fallback logic is solid and the race condition is resolved. Good use of console.error to surface load failures. Recommended next step: add a visible loading skeleton or 'Loading settings...' state in the JSX to prevent the admin from interacting with an empty form during the 500ms retry window (defense in depth).
handleSaveSettings still uses `parseInt(value) || 10` pattern which silently coerces 0/empty to 10. Consider Number.isFinite guard if admin needs to set 0 deliberately (low priority).
React console warning: 'A props object containing a "key" prop is being spread into JSX' in Link components — affects dev console hygiene; not user-facing but worth fixing.

React console warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (AdminLoginPage)' on login — points to a setState inside render or useEffect cleanup issue in AdminLoginPage.js; not blocking but should be fixed.

rca_of_the_original_issue: Original race: AdminSettingsTab mounted and fired fetchSettings(GET /api/admin/settings) before the axios bearer-token (or httpOnly cookie auth context) was fully primed on the very first render after admin login. The 401 was swallowed by an empty catch block, leaving the form state at its initial empty strings. Admin then thought settings were unset and could overwrite saved values. Fix: retry once after a 500ms wait (covers the auth-priming gap), then fallback to the public /api/settings endpoint (which has the same whatsapp_number/telegram_link visible to non-admins), and log all failures with console.error so future regressions are visible in the browser console.
